headline: Oil Prices Fall as Saudi Exports Resume
summary: Oil prices fell as investors focused on the resumption of Saudi Arabia's exports, according to a report datelined Singapore.
why: Saudi Arabia is the largest crude exporter in OPEC, so changes in its export flows directly influence global crude supply and benchmark prices.

source.name: Agence Arabe Syrienne de Presse – SANA

sources.name: Agence Arabe Syrienne de Presse – SANA

why_moved: Investors reacted to the resumption of Saudi Arabian exports, which eases concerns about supply shortfalls.
